system.description:
At 19th level, your casting style reaches its final heights, granting you a new ability based on the choice you made at level 1.

Defensive

You and all allies within your threatened area add your spellcasting ability modifier to all saving throws against spells.

Deflector

When you successfully deflect an attack, the attacker takes damage as if they had struck themself.

Long Range

All of your ranged cantrips now have an infinite range, so long as you can personally see your target.

Offhand

You may now spend your bonus action once per short rest to cast a cantrip which requires a weapon as a component.

Overwhelming

You now treat any roll of a 1 or a 2 on the damage roll of your cantrip as a 6.

Spellbinding

If a creature fails its saving throw against one of your cantrips, you can move it up to 20ft in any direction.
